source_note: Extra IELTS Part 1 topics typed from the owner's screenshots of a Part 1 question list (sent November 2026, topics 2-37; 1 and 24 were not included). 'season' is the exam period the list gave and is kept for reference only; it is not loaded into the database. Topics merge with existing Part 1 topics of the same title, and questions already in a topic are skipped.
fixes_applied: Titles: removed '(always in use)' and the date ranges; they are kept in 'season'.
'Work and studies, schools and workplaces' merged into 'Work and studies'; 'Hometown, area you live in' merged into 'Hometown'.
'Home and accommodation' merged into 'Home, decoration' (same questions; its 2 cut-off questions are the two colour questions already in that topic).
Removed '(added on 25/26 June)' notes and the duplicate questions they created (Music).
'Do you ever (often) get bored?' -> 'Do you ever get bored?'; 'Did (Do) you have a favourite teacher?' -> 'Did you have a favourite teacher?' (matches existing wording).

Matched existing wording: 'Do you like your home town?' -> 'hometown'; 'What work do you do? What subjects...' -> 'What work do you do? / What subjects...'; 'What kinds of movies do you like best?' -> 'What kind of movies...'; 'Do you feel more bored than when you were young?' -> '...more bored now than...'; 'Do you think you could be a teacher?' -> '...a good teacher?'; 'How does this teacher help you?' -> 'How did this teacher help you?'.
Dropped 'Are you an ambitious person?' (same as 'Do you think you are an ambitious person?').
'Do you like traveling?' -> 'travelling'; 'travel in the outer space' -> 'travel in outer space'; 'Sports programs' -> 'Sports programmes' (British spelling, like the rest).
